title: Video by s_sapphire_robotics
description:
Self-stabilizing robots are reaching a fascinating stage where they can walk and balance with little to no AI, relying instead on clever mechanical design and passive dynamics. Sometimes, stability can emerge from physics itself, where motion happens naturally without complex control systems, yet still looks surprisingly lifelike.
